day_start: Another morning, another pile of dents. Coffee's on and the spanners are where I left them.
They come in here thinking they're important. Let's see what they look like by sundown.
Every ship that docks here leaves a little lighter in the wallet and a little heavier in my toolbox. Let's get to work.
release_warning: Not quite there yet. I can fill that slot, but I'll charge you for the part. Buying it yourself is the cheaper road, just saying.
This one's still limping. I'll patch it with a stock part if you say the word, and the bill comes out of your pay. Your call.
Releasing now means I fit a part from my own shelf, and that doesn't come cheap. You'd save more fitting one you bought yourself.
penalty_fill: There, that'll do. Wasn't pretty, but it'll fly. Stock rates, no hard feelings.
Slotted it in from the shelf. Stock parts never complain, and they never come cheap.
Fitted and sealed. Next time, bring a part you've already paid for and we'll both sleep better.
day_end: Doors closed, bays empty. The tally's on the counter, and I earned every bit of it.
That's the last ship of the day. Go on, check the numbers. I'm not nervous, you're nervous.
Good day's work. Tools oiled, bays swept, and a few good parts saved for tomorrow.
bankruptcy: The books have gone red and the coffee's cold. Tomorrow I start again, same as always.
Can't pay the rent on sparks alone. Shut the shutters, I'll find another angle.
Empty till, full toolbox. I've been broke before and I've always come back squeezing.
run_end_win: Look at that. Stranded ships sorted, and every one of them paid up. I'll be bragging about this run for years.
They called this station a junk heap. Let them come back and say it now, I'll be right here with a spanner.
Every ship flying home on a patched part. Best feeling in the galaxy, and I earned it the hard way.
run_end_bankrupt: The shutters are down and the station's quiet. Some runs you squeeze every part and still come up short.
I gave it everything I had, and it wasn't enough this time. Pack the tools, the next lot of limping ships will need me.
Nothing left in the till. The lights stay on for the next mechanic, and I'll remember every lesson this run taught me.
tutorial_hint: That engine is too weak for a fighter, but a freighter would take it.
fallback_hint: That spare in your inventory still has some life in it. Shame to waste it on the scrap heap.
Look at the spare part on screen. Plenty left in that one, if you know which ship it's wanted on.
Don't be too quick to bin things. The part sitting in your inventory would fit another bay happily.
